name: BoardMemberTile - Initials Instead Of A Headshot
description: A director added before anyone uploaded their photo — the first thing a newly added board member looks like. The monogram fills the same square the headshot would, so the row stays aligned rather than leaving one column short. Paired with a bio on purpose: the two fallbacks are independent, and prose usually arrives before the photo does, so the combination is the realistic one rather than a contrived worst case.
